service.description: The in-parameters the Marketing context services share; each service declares what it returns.

Check that the user may open Marketing and resolve their scope and the routes of the root that mounts Marketing's screens: capabilities (each MARKETING_* and MESSAGE_* permission, the derived reads anyRead, audienceRead and reportRead, an edit permission alone reading nothing, and the areas: settings, the administrator's), the organizations of their marketing scope (none for a user who reads nothing of Marketing; every internal organization for a system administrator or a holder of MARKETING_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS, allOrganizations) as options, the active one, the user's party and the links (sharedLinks under the mounting root). Refuses a user without Marketing (MARKETING_UNAVAILABLE), a Projects client contact and a PASS public account among them, and a root that mounts no Marketing screen (MARKETING_CONTEXT).

parameter.name: organizationOptions
parameter.description: The organizations as {value, label}, by name, at most 100

service.description: A record a Marketing screen or mount was given: an organization, a campaign, a list (not a mailbox) or a segment (Marketing.js recordKinds; later phases add the send, the automation and enrollment, P14 a content link, and the event). Answers its kind's name, its organization in the user's scope, a label and a short detail. Refuses a record that does not exist, one outside the scope and an unowned one (awaiting adoption) alike (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), and any record for a user who reads nothing of Marketing. With a capability named (campaignEdit, audienceRead, ...), refuses a user without it (PERMISSION_DENIED). Refuses a user without Marketing (MARKETING_UNAVAILABLE).

parameter.name: recordType
parameter.description: organization, campaign, list, segment, send, automation, enrollment or content

service.description: The options of a Marketing drop-down the user may choose, searched by term in the query ignoring case, with the selected value's label (Marketing.js choiceSources): organizations (those of the user's marketing scope); P2 campaigns (open ones, a parent), people (who work for the organization), currencies, lists and segments (a campaign's links). Later phases add theirs. None for a user who reads nothing of Marketing. Refuses a user without Marketing and an unknown choice.

parameter.name: organizationPartyId
parameter.description: P2: narrows campaigns, people, lists and segments to an organization of the scope

parameter.name: excludeId
parameter.description: P2: a campaign left out of the campaigns (its own parent choice)

parameter.name: campaignSendId
parameter.description: P8: the send whose files sendFiles lists

parameter.name: marketingAutomationId
parameter.description: P11: the automation whose topic automationMembers lists

parameter.name: wikiSpaceId
parameter.description: P14: the space whose pages spacePages lists

parameter.name: contentKindEnumId
parameter.description: P14: the kind of content contentSources lists

parameter.name: marketingCampaignId
parameter.description: P14: the campaign whose organization's pages and files contentSources lists

service.description: The palette's Marketing records, each opening its Marketing screen, with recordEntity and recordId for Assist's search (Marketing.js searchFinds): P2 the campaigns of the scope by id or name; lists (P3), segments (P5), sends (P8) and events (P16) join with theirs. No rows for a user without Marketing.
